page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs, providing a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The memory configuration consists of 64.0 GB of RAM, which translates to 8.0 GB of memory per core. This server does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the instance delivers modest processing performance. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the server in the bottom 25% tier. Similarly, single-threaded compression and decompression tasks show poor performance in the bottom 10%. However, the server achieves average performance in large-block memory bandwidth read and write operations, as well as in Passmark CPU physics and extended instruction tests. Redis SET operations and small-model LLM inference prompt processing also register in the middle 50% tier.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.se1.2xlarge is its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8:1 combined with lower-tier compute speeds. This resource density makes it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-frequency CPU performance. It is suitable for hosting medium-sized in-memory databases, caching layers like Redis, and general-purpose applications requiring a larger memory footprint without intensive computational demands.
